veranderings.blok: Die middelpunt van die handel skuif
veranderings.rede: The block narrates in the past tense, so the identifying sentence reads more naturally in the past too; the protected name is untouched.
'Goed' is informal here; 'goedere' is the standard trade word and the one the lesson's own glossary uses.

veranderings.voor: Twee dinge is hier tegelyk waar en dit hang af waarna jy kyk.
veranderings.na: Twee dinge is hier tegelyk waar, en dit hang daarvan af waarna jy kyk.
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses, and 'afhang' needs the anticipating 'daarvan' before a 'waarna' clause.

veranderings.voor: Albei dinge is waar en die
veranderings.na: Albei dinge is waar, en die
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' that joins two clauses each with its own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: mag 'n mens sê dat hy iets
veranderings.na: mag jy sê dat jy iets
veranderings.rede: 'n Mens ... hy' reads as male for a child reader; 'jy ... jy' is neutral and matches the 'jy' used elsewhere in the lesson.
